tool.name: Kiro
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.description: AWS agentic development environment (IDE, CLI, web) built around spec-driven development; successor to Amazon Q Developer.
tool.pricing: Free (50 credits); Pro $20, Pro+ $40, Pro Max $100, Power $200 per user/mo with 1,000-10,000 credits and add-on credits at $0.04; Enterprise via sales.
tool.statusNote: AWS announced on 2026-04-30 that Amazon Q Developer IDE plugins and paid subscriptions reach end of support on 2027-04-30 and positioned Kiro as the transition path. Kiro Mobile is in preview.
tool.practitionerNote: Default migration target for Amazon Q Developer estates: plan the move before the 2027-04-30 end of support, and use IAM Identity Center with model and MCP allow-lists before enabling Cloud Sessions, which are off by default.

dataResidency.detail: Enterprise content stored in the region where the profile is configured; cross-region Bedrock inference within a geography; free/individual content stored in US East (N. Virginia).

deployment.detail: Desktop IDE and CLI clients with AWS-hosted inference; no self-hosted option.

auditLogging.detail: CloudTrail API events, prompt logs of IDE/CLI chat prompts, and per-user activity reports.

soc2.detail: Kiro compliance page lists HIPAA eligibility and ISO 27001 only; not found in AWS SOC services-in-scope list at review time.

iso27001.detail: Kiro is in scope of AWS ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification (EY CertifyPoint).

iso42001.detail: Not listed on the Kiro compliance validation page at review time.

euAiAct.detail: Assessed limited-risk by product category (general-purpose assistant); no published AWS EU AI Act conformity statement for this product.

licenseRisk.detail: Proprietary AWS service; AWS identity and billing lock-in.
